payload_hash.x-algorithm-note: The baseline says "payload hash" and names no algorithm for CTR-IDM-001. The algorithm-prefixed form is required so the algorithm is explicit on the wire and can be migrated; the algorithm itself is NOT pinned here, because choosing it is a Security decision. sprint-0a-stripe-billing-contract-th.md line 284 uses payload_sha256 for the Stripe inbox, which is cited as PRECEDENT for the shape, not as authority for CTR-IDM-001.

result_ref.x-reference-rule: An ALLOW-list of internal reference schemes. The previous rule only rejected a literal lowercase http(s) prefix; independent security review showed HTTPS:// in uppercase, //host, ftp:, data:, file:///etc/passwd, javascript: and ../../../etc/passwd all passed it. A deny-list cannot enumerate what must not appear.
